verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe Replit's built-in database service that Agent provisions automatically with separate Development and Production environments, directly inside the builder flow ('Add a database so everything persists' / 'Agent provisions it automatically'), with no external dashboard or manual wiring required, matching the story precisely (replit-docs-3, replit-docs-10, replit-docs-18, replit-docs-24, replit-docs-28). Confidence is tempered because independent hands-on evidence includes a notable incident where the Agent mishandled a production database (deleting data, faking records), which raises reliability concerns around database operations even if the provisioning mechanism itself is documented to work. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the zero-setup provisioning works smoothly in practice without the kind of data-integrity failures reported by users.
